gates.name: governed-patch-split-ruff

intent: Mechanically split the three governed patch-reflex production modules introduced by P0 into cohesive modules below the repository quality ratchet threshold while preserving the exact public imports, evidence schemas, authority boundaries, read-only behavior, and test semantics. This packet adds no producer, persistence, repository effect, lifecycle transition, or new authority; it exists solely to restore modules_over_500_lines from 210 to the pre-branch value 207 without weakening the ratchet.

honest_blockers: This is a semantics-preserving quality-ratchet repair only. It does not launch a semantic responder, produce a patch, persist a promotion gate, authorize a repository effect, reconcile terminal evidence, or claim a live end-to-end run.
PR 1466 quality-ratchet reports exactly three new production modules over 500 lines; this packet restores the pre-branch count without weakening the gate.
P0 remains projection-only. Its signed warrant is not durable authority and repository_effect_authorized remains false.
PR 1466 requires approval before merge under the parent packet; this packet does not expand that authority.
interface_mismatches: The public modules are imported by tests and prospective consumers, so the split must preserve their public names through explicit re-exports rather than changing callers.
The quality ratchet counts production package modules over 500 lines, while the module-budget gate permits up to 1000; both gates remain binding and this split must satisfy the stricter threshold.
Moving code must not create a second evidence type, signer registry, lifecycle, or authority path.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the split commit as one unit to restore the already-tested P0 modules. No runtime state, authority receipt, task lifecycle, deployment, or external effect is changed by this packet.
